reason: An element with display: contents, such as a slot, counts as hidden, so names that pass through a slot are empty and getByRole never finds it
A form with a control named localName or tagName loses its role, because the engine reads element.localName
An aria-labelledby that lists the element itself drops the element's own aria-label, value, or content
Hidden descendants of a visible aria-labelledby target still contribute to the name
A name keeps its soft hyphens and zero-width spaces and folds non-breaking spaces into plain spaces
An input type=image ignores its label, and an image or submit input without a value or alt has no default name
A name from content descends into children whose role does not allow name from content
An embedded combobox or listbox contributes all of its options' text, not its selected option, to another element's name
Pseudo-element content is read with a regular expression, so alt text, attr(), url(), and a pseudo on the element itself are mis-parsed
A name includes pseudo-element content that is display: none or visibility: hidden, and does not separate a display: block pseudo from its neighbors
Text in a closed details is included, both in the name of a label that references it and in a snapshot
Differs, pending a decision: Elements with name-prohibited roles, such as a bare <a> or <g>, have empty names even with aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title
SVG elements get no role and no name from their title child: <svg> has no img role
An input whose list attribute does not name a datalist is a combobox
The implicit role table differs from HTML-AAM and axe-core for header and footer, th, img with an empty alt, form, and section
